answer_1.quote: Recent large-scale language models (LMs) have brought numerous breakthroughs in open-domain dialogue systems, yielding human-like responses.

answer_2.quote: Distinct-1/2 is the number of distinct uni-or bi-grams divided by total number of words.

answer_3.quote: We also consider another approach using perplexity (PPL) of large-scale LMs. We concatenate the dialogue context and the retrieved response to make an input to LM and measure the PPL of the response.

answer_4.quote: We ask the crowd workers to rate on a scale of 1 to 5 whether the generated dialogue satisfies several conditions
answer_4.guideline: rate on a scale of 1 to 5 with specific criteria for dialogue quality
